Element.attribute: The activities described here (Initiate, Plan, Execute, Monitor & Control, and Close) can be applied to any size of project in terms of the objectives and principles it describes. Scaling can be achieved by adjusting the level of rigor embodied in the project management work products and deliverables that are developed.
To define the exact tasks and activities that will be taking place for the goals and the scope of the project to be achieved.

Element.Name: initiate_proj
Element.attribute: Define a new project or a new phase of an existing project by obtaining authorization to start the project or phase.

Element.Name: plan_proj
Element.attribute: Establish the scope of the project, refine the objectives, and define the course of action required to attain the objectives that the project is undertaken to achieve.

Element.Name: plan_scope
Element.attribute: Describes the relevant area or subject matter that the project will encompass.

Element.Name: plan_schedule
Element.attribute: Define the course of action required to attain the objectives that the project is undertaken to achieve.

Element.Name: plan_cost
Element.attribute: Establish the policies, procedures, and documentation for planning, managing, expending, and controlling project costs.

Element.Name: plan_risk
Element.attribute: Establish how future events with potential impact to the project will be managed, who will be responsible, and how risk will be communicated throughout the project.

Element.Name: execute_proj
Element.attribute: Deliver the work defined in the project management plan to satisfy the project specifications.

Element.Name: monitor_ctrl_proj
Element.attribute: Track, review, and regulate the progress and performance of the project; identify any areas in which changes to the plan are required; and initiate the corresponding changes.

Element.Name: close_proj
Element.attribute: Finalize all activities across all areas to formally close the project or phase.
